intro_zh: “没怎么变”分三档：completely unchanged 是真的一点没动，remain constant 就是这一档；roughly flat 是基本没变、允许小范围移动，用 remain stable、stay flat；先升或先降、后来停住，用 level off、plateau。波动也分两种：slight fluctuation 是小幅来回，sharp swings 是大起大落。先看幅度大小和时间长短，再决定用哪个词。
intro_en: The words for values that hold steady, flatten out, or swing up and down.

expressions.head: remain stable
expressions.pattern: remain stable + at / around + level / over + period

examples.en: Kestrel's market share remained stable at around 15 percent between 2024 and 2026.
examples.zh: Kestrel 的市场份额在 2024 到 2026 年间稳定在 15% 左右。

examples.en: Rent in this neighborhood has remained stable for two years, even as the cafes around it keep changing.
examples.zh: 这一带的房租两年没怎么变，尽管周围的咖啡馆换了一家又一家。

expressions.contrast_zh: 表示“基本没变”，允许小幅移动，后面常接 at / around 加水平。真要强调一点没动，用 remain constant；只讲持平、语气更口语时，用 stay flat。

expressions.head: remain constant
expressions.pattern: remain constant + at + level / throughout + period

examples.en: The revenue target remained constant at $190K for the whole quarter.
examples.zh: 整个季度里，收入目标一直保持在 19 万美元。

examples.en: The interest rate on my student loan has remained constant, so the monthly payment never changes.
examples.zh: 我的助学贷款利率一直没变，所以每月还款额也一样。

expressions.contrast_zh: 比 remain stable 更严格：数值真的一点没变时才用，常见于目标、费率、固定成本。如果只是在小范围里动，用 remain stable 或 stay flat，别把“大致不变”写成 remain constant。

expressions.head: stay flat
expressions.pattern: stay flat + at / around + level / for + period

examples.en: Vertex's share stayed flat at around 15 percent between 2024 and 2026.
examples.zh: Vertex 的份额在 2024 到 2026 年间基本持平，维持在 15% 左右。

examples.en: My salary has stayed flat for two years while my rent keeps going up.
examples.zh: 我的工资两年没涨，房租却一直在涨。

expressions.contrast_zh: 说的是“大致没变”，允许小数点级别的移动，商务汇报和日常口语都自然。完全没动用 remain constant；先动后停用 level off。

expressions.head: level off
expressions.pattern: level off + at + level / after + period
collocations: level off after a sharp rise

examples.en: After falling for most of the quarter, the churn rate leveled off at around 4 percent.
examples.zh: 流失率在季度大部分时间下降之后，稳定在 4% 左右。

examples.en: Orders leveled off once the holiday promotion ended.
examples.zh: 假日促销结束后，订单量趋于平稳。

expressions.contrast_zh: 强调“先动后停”，前面通常有一段上升或下降，句子里的 after 是常见信号；stay flat 是从头到尾都平，level off 有一个明显的转折点。美式拼写是 leveled，英式 levelled 不用。

expressions.head: plateau
expressions.pattern: plateau + at / near + level / reach a plateau

examples.en: After climbing through January, the share price plateaued around 150 dollars.
examples.zh: 一月一路上涨之后，股价在 150 美元附近进入平台期。

examples.en: My running times plateaued after the first month of training.
examples.zh: 训练第一个月之后，我的跑步成绩就进入了平台期。

expressions.contrast_zh: 比 level off 更强调“长期停在某个水平、很难再突破”，常带一点负面意味；level off 只是中性地描述走势变平。数据只是短暂停一下，用 level off 就够了。

expressions.head: fluctuate
expressions.pattern: fluctuate + between A and B / around + level

examples.en: The share price fluctuated between 116 and 158 dollars during the period.
examples.zh: 这段时间里，股价在 116 到 158 美元之间上下波动。

examples.en: New customers fluctuated between 1210 and 1450 a week, with no clear direction.
examples.zh: 每周新增客户在 1210 到 1450 之间起伏，没有明显方向。

expressions.contrast_zh: 强调反复上下、没有单一方向，幅度可大可小；vary 更偏“对象之间各不相同”，fluctuate 一定和时间上的来回变化有关。小幅来回是 slight fluctuations，大起大落是 sharp swings。

expressions.head: vary
expressions.meaning_zh: 不同；有差异；（随情况）变化
expressions.pattern: vary + from ... to ... / vary between A and B / vary by + factor

examples.en: Delivery times varied widely, from 22 minutes in Hangzhou to 66 in Guangzhou.
examples.zh: 配送时长差别很大，杭州最快 22 分钟，广州最长 66 分钟。

examples.en: Menu prices vary from store to store, so check the app before you order.
examples.zh: 各家门店的菜单价格不一样，下单前先看一眼 app。

expressions.contrast_zh: 横着比不同对象之间不一样时用 vary（vary from city to city）；同一个对象随时间上下动，用 fluctuate。vary 不一定有时间维度，价格、时长、规则都能用。

expressions.head: a slight fluctuation
expressions.pattern: a slight fluctuation in + noun / show slight fluctuations

examples.en: The churn rate showed only slight fluctuations, moving between 4.0 and 4.8 percent.
examples.zh: 流失率只有小幅波动，在 4.0% 到 4.8% 之间移动。

examples.en: A slight fluctuation in temperature is normal in early spring.
examples.zh: 早春气温小幅波动很正常。

expressions.contrast_zh: 名词短语，常放在 There was 或 showed 后面；slight 指幅度小，和时间上的来回次数无关。明显起伏说 sharp fluctuations 或 wide swings。一次下跌不叫 fluctuation，它暗示来回多次。

expressions.head: stabilize
expressions.pattern: stabilize + at / above / around + level / after + period

examples.en: The share price stabilized above 149 dollars in early February.
examples.zh: 二月上旬，股价在 149 美元上方稳住。

examples.en: Prices stabilized after the holiday rush, and the store stopped changing them every week.
examples.zh: 节日抢购结束后价格稳定下来，店里也不再每周调价。

expressions.contrast_zh: 强调从波动走向稳定的过程，常和 at / above / around 连用；remain stable 描述的是已经稳定的状态。stabilize 的主语通常是价格、汇率、销量这类会动的数字。
